errors.evidence: The figure does not define the acronym BPC. In the context of language models, it stands for Bits Per Character, not Bits Per Communication. This is an incorrect interpretation.
The x-axis has a linear scale, as shown by the evenly spaced ticks for 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, and 50.
The tick interval shown on the x-axis is 10 units (which corresponds to 10,000 training steps due to the x10^3 multiplier), not 1000.
